name: lutkepohl_e1
title: Lutkepohl's E1: investment, income and consumption (West Germany)
summary: The textbook three-variable cointegrated system (Lutkepohl 2005, data set E1): West German fixed investment, disposable income and consumption, quarterly 1960-1982, in logs. The rank by parametric bootstrap (drvec, B = 499, shipped in the example's cache) finds one relation; the VEC, who corrects, the two half-lives and the yardstick follow. And an ill-defined fit, the VARMA-VEC(2,1), whose search stops on a ridge: sima declares it, it does not present it as an optimum.
plan: N1 run_gate — the three files (random walks with drift in logs, fue)
N1b canonical_analysis — two components near 1 of three
N1c prepare_vec — purpose "long run", p = 2, case 2 (a restricted constant)
C1 rank_test (B = 499, cached) — r = 0 rejected (LR 58.65, p 0.002), r = 1 not (6.02 against 13.22): r = 1
C2 estimate_vec r = 1 — consumption on income, alpha on income and consumption
C3 test_restriction — investment is weakly exogenous (LR 0.06, p 0.80)
C5 long_run — the textbook half-life 1.9 quarters, the model's 52
C8 evaluate — the yardstick, a caveat
C2 again, q = 1 — the ridge: declared, not an optimum
